summary: TROOPS, Inc., a Hong Kong-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K attaching an October 30, 2026 press release disclosing a non-binding strategic term sheet with Young Platform S.p.A., a European digital asset technology provider, to license exchange technology including source code, matching engine, and wallet systems. The term sheet becomes binding November 1, 2026 and contemplates a license agreement supporting a planned digital asset exchange with EFFORCE Group. No stake, price, premium, or closing date is stated; no board recommendation or advisor is named. The arrangement is a commercial licensing and collaboration contract, not a special situation; watch execution of the license and the separate EFFORCE business combination, which together carry integration and financing risk.
